## What would this do

Describe the feature or new skill — what does it do for the user?

## Why

What problem does it solve? Who benefits?

## How (rough)

Sketch the algorithm. Don't worry about precise code yet — the
maintainer reviews ideas before implementation.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you think of? Why is this approach better?

## Related

Links to similar features in other OSS projects, related issues here,
upstream APIs that would be involved, etc.
